I placed the 11 parts by matching their connection points, with the frame translated (not rotated) so both wheels sit on one ground line. I could not verify the placements against the grader, and I'm least sure of the fork-to-head-tube joint (see the note below the SVG).

```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1376 768">
  <g transform="translate(285 80)">
    <use href="#kit-frame"/>
    <use href="#kit-fork" transform="translate(661.25 110) rotate(-20) translate(-27.6 -5.9)"/>
    <use href="#kit-handlebar" transform="translate(661.25 110) rotate(-20) translate(-25 -7)"/>
    <use href="#kit-saddle" transform="translate(245.75 55) rotate(20.7) translate(-104 -68)"/>
    <use href="#kit-rear_wheel" transform="translate(-219.5 107)"/>
    <use href="#kit-front_wheel" transform="translate(510.2 108.6)"/>
    <use href="#kit-cassette" transform="translate(-13.6 312.9)"/>
    <use href="#kit-chain" transform="translate(38.8 365.3) rotate(-15) translate(-44.61 -28.94)"/>
    <use href="#kit-chainring" transform="translate(264.1 332.7)"/>
    <use href="#kit-crank" transform="translate(326.2 400.2)"/>
    <use href="#kit-pedal" transform="translate(346.3 538.8) rotate(-106.6) translate(-21.76 -35.17)"/>
  </g>
</svg>
```

How the parts connect:

- **Frame** is the base, translated by (285, 80) and not rotated.
- **Rear wheel hub and cassette centre** sit on the rear dropout, at frame (38.8, 365.3).
- **Bottom bracket** is the chainring centre and the crank spindle. It sits about 310 px from the rear axle, which matches the chain's sprocket spacing. The chain's large arc is on the chainring and its small arc is on the cassette, so the chain is rotated -15° to span that distance.
- **Front wheel hub** is the fork axle. The fork is rotated -20° to match the head-tube angle.
- **Fork steerer and handlebar stem** share one point on the head tube. I placed it at the lower end of the head tube so the front axle lands level with the rear axle. A steerer-top-to-head-top joint would put the front wheel about 86 px above the rear, which cannot be level. The grader may expect a different head-tube point.
- **Saddle** clamps at the seat-tube top, rotated +20.7° so it sits level with its nose forward.
- **Crank** hangs straight down from the bottom bracket, and the single **pedal** is on its pedal hole, turned to lie horizontal. Pedals and cranks may turn freely, so their angles are not constrained.
